name: gcs-uploader
title: Quick Cloud Upload
description: Upload files to Google Cloud Storage with optional CDN support.
author: leolionart

commands.name: upload-file
commands.title: Upload Image to Cloud
commands.description: Upload a file to GCS. Auto-checks clipboard first, allows manual selection if empty.

preferences.name: bucketName
preferences.title: GCS Bucket Name
preferences.description: Name of your Google Cloud Storage bucket (without gs:// prefix)

preferences.name: authMethod
preferences.title: Authentication Method
preferences.description: Choose how you want to authenticate with Google Cloud

preferences.name: cdnBaseUrl
preferences.title: CDN Base URL
preferences.description: Optional: CDN URL to use instead of storage.googleapis.com (e.g., https://cdn.example.com)

preferences.name: fixedSize
preferences.title: Fixed Size
preferences.description: Size of the image to attach to the editor (0 for no fixed size)

preferences.name: staticToken
preferences.title: Access Token
preferences.description: Required if 'Use gcloud CLI' is disabled.
